name: 応答待ちのリポジトリ招待行
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied GitHub organization pending-invitation row as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact source crop is 1017 by 97 pixels, a very wide shallow 10.48:1 strip. Preserve this extreme horizontal aspect ratio; fill the whole strip with the row and do not add white bands, blank canvas, surrounding table rows, page context, browser chrome, or card framing.

Match the exact compact row height and horizontal alignment. White background, one thin pale-gray horizontal rule near the top, no vertical dividers. At far left place a small empty gray outlined checkbox. Next, place the same circular white avatar with a red square-pixel mosaic. To its right, show the blue linked username 「asmobbin」 in semibold, with muted gray subtext beneath it reading 「asmobbinさんの返信待ち」. In the center-right area, show muted gray status 「招待保留中」 followed immediately by the small gray overlapping-squares copy icon. At the far right, show the quiet gray text action 「削除」. Keep the row unselected; checkbox stays unchecked.

Use the supplied crop as the authority for row proportions, spacing, alignment, avatar pattern, colors, and type size. Keep all content on one horizontal line except the two-line username/subtitle cell. Preserve generous horizontal gaps exactly as in the source, without making the short status or Remove action too large. No new icons, buttons, labels, backgrounds, badges, or rows.
reviewNotes: Content and state are recognizable, but the candidate canvas is 2170x725 (2.99:1) with large blank bands; assigned source crop is 1017x97 (10.48:1). Registered as needs-correction before one bounded reframing attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
